title: aiws.sync.v1
description: What a sync program leaves in the owner's home for a Zone source (source.kind zone, README “Sources”). status failed fails the refresh with error and keeps the last valid version; fields absent keeps the table's; business_time, produced_at and program go into the table's data_version. Rows are identified by source.def.primary_key and cut to source.def.limit.

error.description: Why the program failed (status failed), in its own words.

business_time.description: When the data itself is from.

produced_at.description: When the program wrote this file.

items.description: field_id → value, each value as the field's type takes it

truncated.description: The program left rows out on purpose.
